summary.en: Open-source clone of the classic io hit: swallow pellets, grow huge and outgrow every player around you.
summary.zh: 经典 io 玩法《球球大作战》的开源实现，前后端齐全。

description.en: Steer your cell to gobble pellets and smaller players while dodging anything bigger than you. Split to dash at enemies or eject mass to make a quick escape.
description.zh: 控制小球吞噬周围颗粒与其他玩家变大，同时避免被更大的球吃掉；可分裂加速、喷射质量逃逸。

tip.en: Needs a Node backend (Socket.IO) — one of the few entries that requires deploying a server. Io games lead on session time and social spread, ideal as the centerpiece of a site-wide lobby.
tip.zh: 需要 Node 服务端（Socket.IO），是收录里少数要部署后端的。io 类游戏在线时长和社交传播效果最好，适合做站内「大厅」主打位。
